  "created_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "database" text NOT NULL,
  "encrypted_password" text,
  "host" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "port" int4 NOT NULL,
  "ssl_mode" text DEFAULT 'require' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,

  "visible" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "connections_ssl_mode_check_4d8cb273" CHECK ("ssl_mode" IN ('disable', 'require', 'verify-full'))
)
